source: ZXNAME0000XZ kernel launches are asynchronous with respect to the host thread: after enqueueing a kernel, the ZXNAME0001XZ can continue while device work is still pending. Code that needs the result, or wants to measure completed kernel time, must synchronize at the appropriate point.[1]
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ 内核启动相对于主机线程是异步的：将内核加入队列后，ZXNAME0001XZ 可以继续，而设备工作仍处于挂起状态。需要结果或想要测量完成的内核时间的代码必须在适当的点同步。[1]
